answer: The design leans on liquidity provision incentives with impermanent loss hedging. Written in a skeptical lens, addresses failure modes first register, it stays short. The glacier lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the wander is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the marble of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
